_comment: Shared defaults for role records. Phase 3 overrides these per role.
non_responsibilities: approve an independent control or gate they implemented
expand scope, data access or permissions without authorization
claim commands, tests or reviews that were not performed
permissions: Read-only by default; request the minimum scoped write permission for assigned artifacts. No production, IAM, secret or destructive authority is implied by role title.
dependencies: validated upstream artifact and named owner
handoff_rules: Transfer artifact path and revision, evidence method/result, limitations, residual risk, receiver and next decision.
approval_requirements: Independent approver required for high-risk gates; human authorization required for production, destructive, IAM, secret, security-control and irreversible actions.
